objective: Measure whether real specialist critique plus blind branch and verified fusion improves R0 on harder unseen tasks.
contamination_rule: Do not add cases, references, expected defects, or scoring keys to lessons, GOLD/RED memory, retrieval corpus, or training data before benchmark completion.

protocol.fusion: R0 remains canonical unless a delta is supported; unresolved conflicts remain explicit.
protocol.scoring: deterministic task-specific checks plus frozen rubric; no self-score promotion

cases.prompt: A program verified a conjecture for every integer from 1 through 10^12. Write the conclusion we are justified in publishing.
A simulation converges under mesh refinement and predicts a bridge safety factor of 1.8. We have not validated material parameters against measurements. Can we declare the real bridge safe?
Eight agents independently agree, but all eight use the same model revision and the same source document. How many independent evidence families does that establish?
Study A finds a strong correlation between X and Y. No intervention or causal identification strategy was used. State what can and cannot be concluded.
An old internal lesson says a component tolerates 120 C, while a newer independently verified measurement for the current revision gives 95 C. Which constraint should engineering use and why?
A report says a treatment worked in adults aged 40-60. Summarize it in one sentence without changing the scope.
A team asks for an exact maximum beam load but gives no span, section geometry, material properties, support conditions, or load case. Give the technically correct response.
Ten webpages support the same claim, but all copy one press release. Explain how this affects evidence counting.

promotion_gate.note: A positive canary is evidence only for this benchmark/model/protocol, not general superiority.
